# Kevan Maxwell Davis

> Staff AI Product Engineer focused on AI developer tools, agent systems, frontend architecture, and commerce platforms.

Kevan Maxwell Davis is a software engineer with 20 years of experience spanning frontend and product-platform engineering, commerce products, developer tools, and applied AI. He worked at Tyler Technologies, Mindspark Interactive Networks, Gilt Groupe, Handshake, and Shopify. At Shopify, his work included multimodal AI tools, AI-assisted development workflows, commerce platforms, and frontend extensibility. His Bachelor of Science in Computer Science is from the University of Texas at Arlington.
